name: Adwave
summary: Advertising platform that plans and runs ads on phones, TV, search and social from your website, paid from a prepaid wallet.
best_for: small businesses that want ads on phones, TV, search and social planned from their website, paid from a prepaid wallet that cannot go into debt
skip_if: you want to compare ad formats and results before creating an account, you need a monthly invoice rather than prepaid funding, or you are an agency that needs the licence price upfront
honest_knock: Most of the product sits behind an account, so we could not see the ad formats, targeting options or reporting before signing up. The agency licence price is not published, and a card top-up costs more than the amount that reaches your wallet.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-09 on waverunner.adwave.com/pricing, the wallet and billing help page) Adwave has no subscription for businesses: you fund a prepaid wallet and live campaigns charge their daily budget from it. A top-up can be any amount from $30 to $50,000, with presets of $100, $250 and $1,000. Card top-ups add the card processing fee on top, so the wallet receives the full amount you chose; bank (ACH) top-ups carry no added fee. Auto-refill is optional, with a default and minimum refill of $100. The page says the daily budget is the whole media bill, there are no hidden fees, and tracking, reporting and API access are free. Your first campaign comes with free starter ads; later ad generation and Ad Library extras use published unit prices that you see before you accept. Agencies pay a monthly licence: the agencies guide read on 15 November 2026 lists Agency $499, Growth $1,999 and Scale $4,999 a month; managed client media is billed at cost from the agency wallet. Re-read on 15 November 2026 with a plain fetch of the wallet and billing page: top-ups $30 to $50,000, presets $100, $250 and $1,000, auto-refill default and minimum $100, unchanged.

compare_with.name: AdCreative.ai
compare_with.why: AdCreative.ai is in our directory and focuses on generating ad creatives, while Adwave also places the media. Compare what each charges for the first campaign and who owns the ad accounts afterwards

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Adwave on an account we created, with a public bakery website as input. Adwave read the site in about 3 minutes and drafted a $50-a-day plan for the whole US, sending about all of it to Facebook and Instagram at that budget. The free starter ads did not arrive: after more than two hours all 5 showed Render failed. Launching needs a wallet top-up; for $50 by card the window showed $51.81 at checkout. Pay was not clicked. Account and start: we created the account with an e-mail code, without a password; our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026 from 09:05 CET, and came back at about 11:10 for the ad preview. The interface was in English. The wallet started at $0.00 with no live daily budget. The test site was kingarthurbaking.com, a public site that is not ours. The dossier name is Adwave and the review is on MSS (mss/adwave-review.html). Core action, a campaign plan from a website: at 09:06 the URL went into Tell us about your business. Reading the site took about 3 minutes and produced a business profile and four buyer profiles. New campaign then built a plan without asking for money: Get known from people in Entire US for $50 a day (about $1,500 a month), all day, every day, no end date, on mobile web, audio, mobile apps, streaming TV, Google, Google Search, Meta and Reddit. The budget split (playbook Social first, Recommended) sends about 100% of $50 a day to Facebook and Instagram; Google joins at $80 a day, phones, web and streaming TV at $120 and YouTube and Gmail at $160, and Reddit sits out because its share is under its daily minimum. There is no price per channel, only shares of the daily budget and thresholds. The plan stood after about 4 minutes. Free starter ads: at 09:09 Make it and wait here started the free sample (included at no creation charge, usually under 30 minutes). By 09:23 the status was still 0 of 4 finished, later 0 of 5. At about 11:10, more than two hours later, the Ads Library held 5 phone ads (square and story formats) and all 5 showed Render failed and the status Failed; Generation details said We couldn't finish this ad. Try again. and This ad is included at no charge. No ad preview could be judged. Refresh generation details was not clicked. Plans: Adwave has no subscription for businesses: you fund a prepaid wallet and the daily budget is the media bill. The top-up window takes any whole-dollar amount from $30 to $50,000, with presets of $100, $250 and $1,000; a card top-up adds a processing fee ($1.81 on $50, $3.30 on $100) and a bank account top-up has no card fee. Auto-refill is an unticked box that adds $100.00 (card charged $103.30) when the balance drops below about 3 days of spend. On the review screen the launch options were Keep my ads running at $206.29 today or I'll add money myself at $51.81 today. Checkout: the review screen said at most $50.00 today, first day of ads up to $50.00, making your ads included, paid from the wallet with $0.00 available, and that the wallet was $50.00 short of the first day. The top-up window Add funds, then launch, with 50 entered, showed Added to wallet $50.00, Card processing $1.81 and Charged at checkout $51.81, and the button Pay $51.81 at secure checkout, which opens Stripe checkout. It was not clicked and Cancel closed the window, so the Stripe page and any tax line were not seen. Every step screen says Your plan is saved. Your budget isn't set aside or charged until you launch. Cancelling: Settings, Close your workspace says it stops campaigns, cannot be undone, forfeits unused free ad money and keeps billing records; Review workspace closure was not clicked. Nothing was launched, so pausing or ending a campaign was not tried. Not tested: launching a campaign, a top-up, the Stripe page, tracking, the agency licence and refunds of unused wallet money. Clean up: the account and the test business with the draft campaign Get known and a $0.00 wallet stay. The own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The free starter ads never finished: all 5 ended in Render failed, so you cannot judge an ad before paying. At $50 a day the plan lists eight channels, but about all of the budget goes to Facebook and Instagram; Google needs $80 a day and TV $120. A card top-up adds a fee on top of the amount.
